content.body:
You did everything right. Eight hours of sleep, the coffee, the early night. And you are still wiped out

by the afternoon.

It is not always sleep, and it is not always stress. Sometimes the tired has a number behind it, one

your checkup probably skipped right past.

It is called ferritin, and low is low long before anything ever shows up as anemic. You cannot fix a

number you never see.

So ask for it. And if it is low, iron and folate are the two things your body runs on, in a strip you will

actually take.

Ask for the number. Then see what is inside.

content.body:
For months my legs felt like concrete on every run and nobody could tell me why. Not my coach. Not even my doctor.

The answer was one number on a blood test that everyone swore was totally normal.

It was my ferritin. My iron stores.

My doctor saw it and said I was fine. But for a runner, that "fine" number was basically empty. I needed around 50. I was sitting at 18.

I'd tried iron pills. They wrecked my stomach, so I always quit, and the number never budged. Then I found the thing that finally moved it. 👇

This is not that. It is ferric iron in a raspberry strip you let melt on your tongue. Once a day. No pill to

fight.

Iron you can actually keep taking, instead of one more bottle you start and abandon.

See exactly what is inside.

content.body:
If your doctor told you your ferritin is "low normal" while your hair is falling out and you're exhausted, you're not crazy.

You're not lazy. You're not depressed. You're not "just stressed."

You have a ferritin problem your pills can't fix.

Here's the thing nobody tells you: your gut can only absorb 10 to 15% of any iron pill you swallow. Doesn't matter if it's bisglycinate, ferrous sulfate, Floradix, or Thorne. Same ceiling. Different label.

CAVAÉ Melt is a raspberry strip that dissolves on your tongue in 30 seconds and skips your gut entirely. A different route to the bloodstream.

Real women are watching their ferritin move 30+ points in 8 to 12 weeks.

Tap to see how it works →
